europe_now.title: Russian double‑tap strike hits Ukrainian mall
europe_now.summary: Rescue teams are searching through the wreckage of a Ukrainian mall after a Russian double‑tap drone strike killed at least fifteen people. The strike wounded 130 people and was condemned by Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky as despicable.

sources.headline: Rescuers dig through Ukraine mall wreckage as Zelensky condemns 'despicable' Russian strike
Russian strikes Zelensky's hometown in Ukraine, killing 15 people, wounding 130

europe_now.title: European officials call for halt to West Bank settlement expansion
europe_now.summary: Over one hundred former French and British diplomats have urged their governments to act against Israeli settlement policies in the occupied West Bank. The diplomats accuse Israel of ethnic cleansing and join European leaders in calling for a halt to settlement expansion.

sources.headline: More than 100 former French and UK diplomats urge action against Israeli settlement policies
100 UK, French ex-ambassadors accuse Israel of ethnic cleansing in open letter

top_stories.title: France pledges interceptor missiles to Ukraine
top_stories.summary: France has announced it will deliver interceptor missiles to Ukraine to bolster its air defences. The decision follows a fresh wave of Russian strikes on Ukrainian territory.

sources.headline: France to deliver interceptor missiles to Ukraine after fresh wave of Russian strikes

top_stories.title: European research funding shortfall threatens sovereignty
top_stories.summary: The French Academy chief Françoise Combes warns that European laboratories suffer from chronic underfunding. She argues that this underfunding puts Europe's scientific sovereignty at risk.

sources.headline: [Interview] Europe’s labs are chronically underfunded and sovereignty is at stake, says French Academy chief Françoise Combes
